info.name: Trackzo API
info.description: Complete API collection for Trackzo Time Tracker app. Set the {{baseUrl}} variable to http://192.168.1.26:3000/api and {{token}} to your JWT after logging in.

request.description: Register a new user or admin. Role = 'Admin' triggers company provisioning.
Returns JWT token and user object. Save the token to {{token}} variable.
OTP is currently hardcoded as 9999 in dev mode.
Returns user with their shift details joined.
Validates geofence if enabled. Records status as On Time or Late.
Calculates overtime hours. Creates check-out notification.
Returns total, used, remaining + byType breakdown
Returns geofence, payroll, camera settings, theme colors, logo
Returns company holidays + global holidays (company IS NULL)
Sends checkout reminder to all employees who are still checked in.
